hack.root_cause: Misconfiguration (copy/paste error) in yUSDT — wrong Fulcrum USDC address used instead of USDT → share price manipulation → 1.2 quadrillion yUSDT minted
hack.description: Yearn's legacy yUSDT contract — live for 1,156 days with a copy/paste error using the wrong Fulcrum address since deployment — was exploited for $11.4M; a last-minute Twitter warning was useless because the contract is immutable.
